disclosure: Each row is a separately identified category research item, not a verified investment product, riskometer, market quote or permission. All 95 category archetypes now have at least one general public official framework fact referenced and checked; no actual scheme-level risk-o-meter, investor eligibility, market-data license, tax or purchasable product has been authenticated by these references.
